A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Around her, as her world makes them: a glowing self-unrolling mat; a long crusty baguette in a slim, softly glowing paper sleeve; a glass of glowing liquor on a lit base; glowing wireless ear-pieces.
Season: autumn — mild, changeable days and cool nights, the avenue trees turning gold.
Time of day: the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street; the warm low sun rim-lighting her hair.
Outfit: a body-hugging ribbed knit mini dress that traces every curve of bust, waist and hips, with high heels — in a soft pastel palette such as powder pink, baby blue, mint or lavender; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a thin velvet choker, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the right of the frame; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the right of the frame; camera slightly above, looking down at her; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.

RIGHT HAND: her own right hand holds a V sign turned sideways, the two fingers lying horizontal beside her eye at cheekbone level — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.

EXPRESSION: brows level, eyes bright and steady, closed-lip smile with a firm mouth.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a palm-sized glass pyramid unfolding a slowly turning lattice of light — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

observations: Square waist-up seated view; lateral V gesture uses two extended fingers with remaining fingers curled; other hand rests on chair.
Recognizable face and blue-grey braid, fitted knit dress and picnic scene; no clear anatomy error.
